trigger.chart: A close beyond the pattern's line by 0.1 ATR, on at least 1.3× the 20-candle average volume (harmonics: price reaches the D zone and the candle turns)
trigger.deck-multi: A close beyond the pattern's line by 0.2 ATR
trigger.deck-short: A close beyond the pattern's edge
trigger.deck-candle: A later candle (within 3) closes beyond the candle pattern's high (buy) or low (sell)
